 Dean Wade (ankle) listed questionable Thursday 
 by Ari Koslow | 76ers Correspondent | Wed, Oct 21st 2026, 6:21pm EDT 
 Dean Wade is listed as questionable for Thursday’s game against the Cavaliers. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Wade did not play in Tuesday's opener. He was able to workout prior to the game. His absence most impacts the minutes for Jabari Walker.
